_comment: Candidate profile for Bosch (SmartRecruiters) applications. 3_bosch_job_apply.py loads this file automatically at startup - if present, its values OVERRIDE the built-in constants in the script. Edit here, never in the source. resume_path uses the same prepared resume as the Mercedes automation. expected_graduation uses MM/YYYY as the portal shows it (10.2027); preferred_period_start is DD.MM.YYYY (01.10.2027). Bilingual answers must match SmartRecruiters option labels (e.g. 'Ja/Yes', 'Nein/No', 'Vollzeit / full-time').
